hero.label: Semester Abroad · 2026
hero.title: A visual diary of the months I called Europe home.
hero.description: From slow mornings in Rome to spontaneous weekend trains, this journal gathers the small details, the messy in-betweens, and the moments I never want to forget.

sections.label: Rome
sections.title: Finding a rhythm in the city of endless layers
sections.description: My home base: cobblestone streets, grocery runs in Italian, late-afternoon light on terracotta rooftops, and the tiny routines that slowly turned Rome into home.

sections.label: Weekend Trips
sections.title: Chasing new cities between classes and deadlines
sections.description: Fast trains, packed backpacks, and just enough time to fall in love with somewhere new. These are the quick escapes that shaped the semester in unexpected ways.

sections.label: Food
sections.title: Meals that anchored me to each place
sections.description: Plates of cacio e pepe, flaky pastries eaten on the go, market finds, and long dinners with new friends. This space is for the flavors I never want to forget.

mapPreview.label: Map Preview
mapPreview.title: Tracing everywhere this semester takes me
mapPreview.description: A real map view of Rome and the weekend trips that orbit around it. Each marker is a place I'll eventually fill with photos and stories.
